title: Nonempty nodal geometric fibres of proper curve families
statement: Fix a scheme $S$ [def-pc-scheme] in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention] and a scheme $T$ over $S$. Let $X\to T$ be a proper curve family in the sense of [def-sfb-proper-curve-moduli], with its specified algebraic space, projection and family properties. Define the predicate of nonempty nodal geometric fibres as follows. For every algebraically closed field $\Omega$ [def-weil-field], [def-weil-algebraic-closure] in the scheme universe and every $a:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to T$, form the actual presheaf pullback $X\times_{h_T}h_{\operatorname{Spec}\Omega}$. Its point space [def-a1-space-point-topology] must be nonempty. For every representable etale scheme chart $U$ of this fibre [def-trf-algebraic-space], $U$ is pure of dimension one [def-weil-pure-dimension], and each point $x\in U$ is either smooth over $\Omega$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], meaning it admits an open neighbourhood on which the structural map to $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ is smooth, or is an ordinary geometric node in the existing sense of [def-sfb-ordinary-geometric-node]. The map from $U$ to $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ is the composite with the second pullback projection. Empty etale charts are allowed, while the entire fibre must be nonempty. No connectedness, genus or characteristic restriction is imposed. This defines a predicate on the already defined ProperCurveFamily, without redefining the ambient moduli category or its cartesian arrows.

Compared with the live and side-live node, the delivery changes only three things: an inline citation [def-trf-algebraic-space] for 'representable etale scheme chart', that id added to stmt_deps, and a split_report plus new search entries. The predicate and its Lean record are unchanged, and there are no new nodes. The item is still open in stage 1: live status is split with only a stage-2 reviewed_lean and no repair note. I checked the statement against Stacks 0DSY (lemma-nodal-curves) and 0C46/0C47 (curves.tex definition-nodal). Pure dimension 1 on every etale chart is the etale-local form of equidimensionality. The nonempty-fibre clause is a deliberate refinement, consistent with its only citer lem-sfb-nodal-curve-stack-smooth. Requiring 'smooth or node' at all points is equivalent to requiring it at closed points, because the smooth locus is open and nodes are isolated. An abstract ring isomorphism of the completion with Ω[[u,v]]/(uv) is enough here because the setting is equal characteristic. Edge cases checked: empty base, empty fibre, disconnected union, curve plus a point, characteristic 2, cusp. The added stmt_dep is genuinely needed: the Lean definition (CurveModuliGroupoids.lean, read without compiling) uses AlgebraicSpace.IsEtale, which is owned by def-trf-algebraic-space. Batch-5 check: def-trf-algebraic-space is a general definition of algebraic spaces and representable etale maps. It is not a step of the trace-formula or Poincaré-duality proofs, and it was already in the item's closure through def-sfb-proper-curve-moduli and def-a1-space-point-topology, so I accept it.
